data.title: 春原瞬 · 床榻温存的极致欢愉依赖
data.description: 华丽雅致的深绯色丝绸大床上，暖玉般的床头灯洒下催情光晕。瞬身着半透的深绯真丝蕾丝吊带睡裙，如瀑黑发凌乱铺散在枕上。她侧卧依偎在老师怀抱中，丰满迷人的成熟玉体曲线毕露，绿色眼眸满溢着甘愿交托一生的极致柔顺与娇羞情潮。
data.action: reclining on silk sheets, hugging close, flushed sensuality, sheer silk lingerie, devoted gaze
data.lighting: deep romantic golden bedside lamp casting seductive amber glow
data.mood: overwhelming sensual devotion, supreme bliss, and passionate abandonment
data.promptProse: Reclining on a lavish silk bed in sheer burgundy lace lingerie, Sunohara Shun hugs close with melting green eyes, her voluptuous silhouette bathed in warm romantic amber light.
data.animaCaption: Shun reclining on a silk bed in sheer burgundy lingerie with devoted affection.
